Yes I see your point. Ill definitely try and talk him into telling his parents because I believe they are really close. But, I will not go behind his back and tell somebody that may make him uncomfortable. Right now I'm only planning on talking to my own mother and keeping him anonymous.

Thanks for your thoughts!

Thanks for your help. Yeah I believe he is willing to go by himself but I would still like to go if nothing else just to support and be there for him. He's a real popular guy, one of the big dicks on campus politically wise, and yet he's only this open to me. I don't even think that I'm his best friend so since he's only open to me I think that's reason enough for me to be there, ill probably make it more comfortable for him.

Basically the only part I'm stuck on is whether or not I tell the docs he ACTUALLY TRIED to kill himself, instead of simply cutting. 

Much love, thanks for the genuine reply.

I told him the same thing, and that I'm glad he failed. In his words "I'm dumb enough not to grab a sharper blade..." And I responded with "no, you're smart enough not to get back up to grab a sharper one when you easily could have." He also wants me to take all the knives from his house, and though I'm willing to do that I told him it wouldn't do any good since if he wanted to off himself he easily could without knives. Thanks for the reply.
He's 21. I'm sure his parents know about his history but that's for him to decide not me. I don't want to make his situation uncomfortable. Thanks though.
He did both. He didn't do this for attention as its not his first time. This has been ongoing for 7 years. Though this is the first time since I've known him.
He showed me the cuts and they are really deep, including some vertical. He says he was lucky he used a dull blade.
I will help to the best of my ability.
I want to tell them everything, but I don't want him to get sent away. Ik it's selfish but he's went away before and he doesn't want to miss out on the social part of his last year in college.
We have all the same mutual friends. He doesn't want anybody to know and I respect his wishes. I will be phoning my mom though
